capabilities.name: EngineeringRunService
capabilities.description: Own live handles; persistent facts belong only to EngineeringSessionStore.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.doc: Expose one committed snapshot for initial and reconnect hydration.

methods.name: current_snapshot
methods.doc: Discover current identity, then apply the same read-only freshness checks.

methods.name: current_session_id
methods.doc: Resolve committed current identity without claiming fresh acceptance.

methods.name: request_identity
methods.doc: Read committed request identity only; it carries no current verdict.

methods.name: find_request
methods.doc: Read saved request identity through the same workspace owner.

methods.name: wait
methods.doc: Join the existing owner, including its physical cleanup, without a new run.

methods.name: chat_role
methods.doc: Discuss through native K1 without engineering admission or action tools.

methods.name: consult_role
methods.doc: Return one read-only answer within the current Director's owned run.

methods.name: run_collaborative
methods.doc: Run actual PM, CE and Director loops once, retaining ordinary advice.
